up: Return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and maximum phase for all approved drugs (max_phase = 4). Include the mechanism of action description, the action type, and the target ChEMBL ID and preferred name. The mechanism of action must be a positive modulator (action_type parent_type = 'POSITIVE MODULATOR'). Join drug_mechanism to molecule_dictionary, action_type, and target_dictionary.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS drug_pref_name, md.max_phase, dmmech.mechanism_of_action, dmmech.action_type, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name FROM drug_mechanism dmmech JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dmmech.molregno = md.molregno JOIN action_type atype ON dmmech.action_type = atype.action_type JOIN target_dictionary td ON dmmech.tid = td.tid WHERE atype.parent_type = 'POSITIVE MODULATOR' AND md.max_phase = 4
